facets.description: OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut javadoc says '3-letters' shortcut, but the decoder in DefaultTokenContextEncoderProvider hard-codes 2-char shortcuts and a 6-char prefix; the javadoc must say exactly 2 characters
Shortcut length is never validated (not in encodeTokenId or factory postInit/registration), so a shortcut that isn't 2 characters only fails when the token ID is decoded
